head: 179539c617aef6f4e2ffe27a9d741c156ffe0e68
decision: ORDERING REPAIR SUPPORTED; ONE PAUSED-RETENTION FENCE FINDING
supported: Prospective preview detail composition now precedes base/mask/value/ready writes; first failure with no predecessor is pending rather than retained ready.
A displayed current preview retains its original pixels/identity on failed B; successful retry commits B.
Refined detail composition precedes background/painted identity. Its temporary composed class restores prior state on throw, and original acceptedJob is rechecked before final commit.
Global refined worker failure retains only independently current paintedJob and cancels pending replacement. Currentness loss still clears.
No demonstrated additional warranted/current silent-clear counterexample was established; a broader detail-composition API change is not required by this review.

intake/preview-atomic-r109-red.tap.result: 2 behavioral failures: unpublished first preview reported ready, failed B replaced old identity

intake/refined-atomic-r109-red.tap.result: 3 behavioral failures: first/replacement background writes and expired final write

findings.observation: Both failure paths with a previously displayed value use publishable(value, retained) without rejecting retained.paused. nativeResultCurrent/nativeIdentity validate source identity and age, not paused. A pending decode rejection after the page becomes hidden can therefore mark the old preview retained, unlike retainFirstPaint and normal final commit.
findings.smallestControl: Displayed current A, pending changed-mask decode, set paused before rejecting decode: require withdrawal, not retained. Cover the preparation-exception path with the same predicate.
findings.limit: Source-supported control counterexample; no native visible loss asserted, no browser/control executed by reviewer.

limits: Controls use actual host bodies and mask owner with substituted browser/detail transports; not native pixel continuity or a complete product qualification.
Built/generated successor and applicable native observations still require exact binding.
Prior TA1 map remains immutable; its atomic-publication finding is addressed for the reviewed exception paths, subject to this remaining pause fence.
authority: Read-only source recommendation; no effect, merge, closure or qualification authority.
